items.source: In a Servlet 3+ container, SockJsHttpRequestHandler can be used to invoke this service. The processing servlet, as well as all filters involved, must have asynchronous support enabled through the ServletContext API or by adding an <async-support>true</async-support> element to servlet and filter declarations in web.xml.
items.translation: 在 Servlet 3+ 容器中，可以使用 SockJsHttpRequestHandler 来调用此服务。处理 servlet 以及所有涉及的过滤器必须通过 ServletContext API 启用异步支持，或者在 web.xml 中的 servlet 和过滤器声明中添加 <async-support>true</async-support> 元素。

items.source: See the "Base URL", "Static URLs", and "Session URLs" sections of the SockJS protocol for details on the types of URLs expected.
items.translation: 请参阅SockJS 协议中的“Base URL”、“Static URLs"和“Session URLs"部分，以了解预期的 URL 类型。

items.source: SockJsException - raised when request processing fails; generally, failed attempts to send messages to clients automatically close the SockJS session and raise SockJsTransportFailureException; failed attempts to read messages from clients do not automatically close the session and may result in SockJsMessageDeliveryException or SockJsException; exceptions from the WebSocketHandler can be handled internally or through ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator or some alternative decorator. The former is automatically added when using SockJsHttpRequestHandler.
items.translation: SockJsException - 在请求处理失败时抛出；通常，向客户端发送消息的失败尝试会自动关闭 SockJS 会话并抛出SockJsTransportFailureException；从客户端读取消息的失败尝试不会自动关闭会话，并可能导致SockJsMessageDeliveryException 或SockJsException；来自 WebSocketHandler 的异常可以通过内部处理或通过ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator 或某些替代装饰器来处理。前者在使用SockJsHttpRequestHandler时会自动添加。

items.source: sockJsPath - the remainder of the path within the SockJS service prefix
items.translation: sockJsPath - SockJS 服务前缀内的路径剩余部分

items.source: handler - the handler that will exchange messages with the SockJS client
items.translation: handler - 将与 SockJS 客户端交换消息的处理器
处理 SockJS HTTP 请求。
